reason: Mere customers phone karke order dete hain, WhatsApp pe type bahut kam karte hain. Udhaar meri diary mein hai aur kaam chal raha hai, UPI QR bhi hai. Ek aur cheez roz sambhalni padegi, mujhe nahi chahiye.
